frame.note: drawing frame: origin at the part's bounding-box corner; Z = sheet normal (flat) or the smallest extent; X the longer of the other two. Datum C = the x = 0 edge, B = the y = 0 edge, A = the z = 0 face.

bend_edge.quote: Bend-to-edge tolerance: +/- 0.015″ (each additional bend adds at least 0.015″)

flat.source: mechloop class value (tolerance/process.py sheet flat, 2 standard deviations); SendCutSend publishes none for this

predictions.finding: nut_keeper_fl: 1 hole(s) with less than 3.175 mm of material to the edge (least 1.85 mm at [-160.8, -82.0, 128.07]): the web overheats and distorts, and tears if the part is bent or loaded.
nut_keeper_fl: 1 tab(s) or neck(s) narrower than 3.175 mm, the sheet's thickness (narrowest about 2.62 mm at [-131.8, -89.75, 128.07]): they warp from the heat of the cut and bend in handling.

nut_keeper_fl: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_edge_al6061_page: hole edge to part edge 1.85 mm (2 of 2), limit >= 4.76 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "Keep holes and cutouts 1.5–2× material thickness away from edges to prevent warping or distortion.").

nut_keeper_fl: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_edge_d_ratio: hole edge to part edge 1.85 mm (1 of 2), limit >= 3.4 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "we generally recommend keeping your holes at least 1X their diameter from an edge and slots at least 1.5X their width away from edges or other cut features.").

nut_keeper_fl: 1 outside corner(s) of the cut profile are dead sharp (no radius). A sheet part with needle corners cuts hands and cables and chips its paint; a corner radius costs nothing in laser or waterjet cutting.
